svg.text: A stock ABS box base with four moulded corner pillars. Drill only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sizes are from the box's centre lines; the drilling layout repeats them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor, 24 mm boss hole: 20 mm left of centre, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor, four 3.2 mm stand-off screw holes: 33 mm each side, 13 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor, four 3.2 mm carrier screw holes: 3.5 mm left of centre and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 35 mm right of centre, 25 mm each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left end wall: two 12.2 mm gland holes 13 mm each side of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Right end wall: one 16.2 mm gland hole on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gland centres 15.5 mm up from the underside of the box.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the face, pilot 3 mm slowly with wood behind, open with a step

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill at low speed, light pressure. Deburr inside and out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each gland seats flat; the floor holes match the block's.
